#p3001106# has given you #p3001008#'s personal commission. #p3001008# is preparing a flashy stage for Angelic Buster to perform on.

Collect #b100 #t4000730##k items, from #o2400109# enemies at the #m401010010# and the #m401040100#, to start building the stage.

0.1: Anyway, get #b100 #t4000730##k items and bring them to #p3001008#.

yes.0: #b#t4000730##k items can be obtained from #r#o2400109##k monsters!

no.0: I have a bunch of other people lining up to help me out, #b#e#h0##k#n!

1.0: Hey there! Do you have the items I commissioned?

yes.0: Great. Great. Great, great, great. I can't wait to see Angelic Buster live on stage!
